equivalent_formulations.evidence: An edge-multiset resolving set is equivalent to assigning pairwise distinct edge-distance histograms. The weighted certificate is a lower bound on the total score of \(E_d=d2^{d-1}\) distinct capacity-bounded histograms.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: This formulation turns nonexistence into a finite exact integer comparison \(L>T\).
